paragraphs: He said in the name of Rav. See [Chagigah 5a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chagigah.5a.18).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rav Bardela bar Tavyomi speaking in Rav’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=784&lang=en) records the same transmission. Hyman quotes only the attribution.
